title: Cover Telegram missing-session code through real local and cold remote-proxy routes
outcome: Route-level behavior protects the local missing-session code and strips upstream codes on cold proxy failures.
acceptance: A route-level test requests a definitively missing local session id and observes HTTP404 with code local_session_missing from the real GET /api/sessions/{id} handler.

A route-level cold proxy test uses a fake remote returning HTTP404 with error and code local_session_missing, then observes that the local response omits that code and Telegram retains retryable state.
